llm_status: error: SHADE_API_URL / SHADE_API_KEY are not set

findings.title: AWS access key ID
findings.explanation: A credential committed to git is readable by everyone with repository access and stays in history even after it is deleted.
findings.fix: Remove the value, load it from an environment variable or secret manager, and rotate the exposed credential.
